title: CallMessage
description:
This enumeration represents the available call messages for interacting with
the `sov-sequencer-registry` module.

oneOf.description: Add a new sequencer to the sequencer registry.

amount.description: The initial balance of the sequencer.

da_address.description: The Da address of the sequencer you're registering.

oneOf.description:
Increases the balance of the sequencer, transferring the funds from the sequencer account
to the rollup.

da_address.description: The DA address of the sequencer.

oneOf.description: Initiate a withdrawal of a sequencer's balance.

da_address.description: The DA address of the sequencer you're removing.

oneOf.description: Withdraw a sequencer's balance after waiting for the withdrawal period.

da_address.description: The DA address of the sequencer you're removing.

oneOf.description:
Rotates the sequencer's DA address without unstaking.

The caller must own `old_da_address`. The rotation preserves balance,
balance state, and the preferred-sequencer pointer. Preferred sequencer
self-rotations during their own batch are applied at end-of-block.

new_da_address.description: The new DA address. Must not already be registered.

old_da_address.description: The sequencer's current DA address (the one being rotated away from).

MockAddress.description: Mock address; 32 bytes in hex-encoded format
